Last Date 1 December 2026, 06:00 pm IST (receipt)

The official notification does not specify the application fee.

About NaBFID

The National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) has been set up under an Act of Parliament, the NaBFID Act, 2021, as the principal entity for infrastructure financing in the country. It is regulated and supervised as an All-India Financial Institution (AIFI) by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). According to the notice, NaBFID supports infrastructure funding by developing innovative financing instruments, bond and derivatives markets, and data-driven risk management.

Where and How to Send

NaBFID accepts applications for this post only by email. The notice states that no other mode of application will be accepted and hard copies are not to be sent.

  1. Visit the link given against the job position for the detailed role description.
  2. Prepare your CV, including a passport sized photograph.
  3. Send the CV by email to [email protected].
  4. Write the subject line strictly as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF <Job Code>". The job code printed for this post is NABFID/EVP/16.
  5. Make sure the email is received on or before 1 December 2026 by 06:00 pm IST.

Candidates should have a valid email ID and keep it active till the declaration of result, as call letters and interview advice will be sent by email.

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

The advertisement covers a single post in the grade of Executive Vice President: Sl. No. 01, EVP & Head- Market Risk, ALM & Enterprise Risk, Job Code NABFID/EVP/16, 1 vacancy (UR).

Educational Qualification

  • Graduate /Postgraduate in any discipline from a recognized University / Institution or a Chartered Account.
  • Preferred: Certification in Financial Risk Management from Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP) OR Professional Risk Management Certification from PRIMA Institute.

Experience

  • Minimum 20 years of experience in financial sector.
  • Of these, 5 years should be in risk management function (in RBI regulated entity).
  • Of these 5 years, 2 years should be at senior management level.
  • Experience in the infrastructure domain will be preferred.

Age Limit

The age limit is 55 years and below, as on the date of advertisement. After applying all relaxations in terms of age, the maximum age of candidates shall not exceed 55 years. Candidates should satisfy themselves about their eligibility as on the cut-off date, 3 November 2026.

Nationality

The notice invites applications from Indian Citizens.

Pay and Terms of Engagement

  • Remuneration will be offered based on qualifications, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark, and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates. No fixed amount is printed in the notice.
  • Contractual engagement will be for a period of 5 years, which may be renewed for additional terms at the discretion of the Bank.
  • Location of position: Mumbai. Selected candidates may be posted in the Bank's establishment in Mumbai/New Delhi/Anywhere in India, as per the Bank's discretion and requirement.
  • Engagement of the selected candidate is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Bank.

Candidates should check the detailed role description linked in the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

NaBFID Recruitment 2026 Job Description

  • Responsible for developing and implementing NaBFID's enterprise-wide risk framework.
  • Ensuring that the Bank's portfolio is built within the defined risk parameters.
  • Building appropriate mechanisms to measure risk.
  • Providing advice and structuring risk mitigation into the business operations at NaBFID.

A detailed role description is available as a separate document on the NaBFID website, linked from the notice.

Enclosures

  • CV including a passport sized photograph (with the email application).
  • No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview, for candidates serving in Govt./Quasi Govt. offices, Public Sector undertakings including Nationalised Banks and Financial Institutions.
  • Details of criminal case(s) pending, if any, at the time of interview.
  • Proper relieving letters from the employer at the time of taking up the appointment, in case of selection.

Selection Process

Applications will be screened and shortlisted on the basis of eligibility and relevant experience, and the requisite number of shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

  • Screening and shortlisting: based on eligibility and relevant experience. Merely satisfying the eligibility norms does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.
  • Additional assessment: shortlisted candidates may undergo psychometric tests and/or assessment centre and/or any other selection method deemed suitable by NaBFID, in addition to the personal interview.
  • Personal Interview: conducted by a committee constituted for this purpose.
  • Final selection: made on the basis of eligibility, experience, qualification and performance during the Personal Interview. Selection is solely at the discretion of NaBFID's Selection Committee, and its decision will be final.

The intimation or call letter for interview will be sent by email or uploaded to the Bank's website. No hard copy of the interview letter will be shared.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Advertisement (Mumbai) 3rd November 2026
Application Start Date 3rd November 2026
Last Date to Apply (receipt by email) 1st December 2026, 06:00 pm IST
Cut-off Date for Eligibility 3rd November 2026

Important Instructions

  • Candidates appearing for the interview process will be reimbursed for economy class airfare expenses.
  • Government, quasi-government, PSU, nationalised bank and financial institution employees who fail to submit the NOC at interview may not be considered, and travelling expenses otherwise admissible will not be paid.
  • Intimations will be sent by email only to the email ID and mobile number provided; the Bank is not responsible if they do not reach candidates due to a change in contact details, technical fault or otherwise.
  • The Bank may conduct independent verification, including police records, and reserves the right to deny the engagement depending on such disclosures or verification.
  • If a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms or has furnished false information or suppressed material facts, the candidature will be cancelled; if detected after appointment, services are liable to be terminated without notice.
  • NaBFID reserves the right to amend, rescind or re-advertise the position at any time without assigning any reasons.
  • Decisions of the Bank on eligibility, interviews, other tests and selection are final; no representation or correspondence will be entertained.
  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai, and courts, tribunals and forums at Mumbai have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • All changes, updates and corrigenda will be hosted only on the careers page of the Bank's website (nabfid.org/careers); no separate intimation will be issued.

The Export-Import Bank of India (India Exim Bank) has announced a recruitment drive for Management Trainee and Manager posts in 2026. The bank invites applications from eligible candidates for a total of 120 positions, including 90 Management Trainee and 30 Manager vacancies.

The short recruitment notice was published on 11 November 2026, and the last date for submitting applications is 11 December 2026. Interested candidates can visit the official Exim Bank careers website for the detailed advertisement, eligibility conditions and online application information.

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 27-11-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 11-12-2026
  • Written Examination Date: December 2026 (Tentative)

Exim Bank Vacancy 2026 - Post Details

India Exim Bank has announced 120 vacancies for Management Trainee and Manager positions. The recruitment includes 90 Management Trainee vacancies and 30 Manager vacancies. The post-wise details are provided below:

Post Name No. of Posts
Management Trainee (MT) 90
Manager 30
Total 120

By category, the 90 Management Trainee posts are UR 40, SC 07, ST 09, OBC (NCL) 25 and EWS 9 (including 03 PwBD). The 30 Manager (Grade/Scale MM II) posts are UR 15, SC 03, ST 02, OBC (NCL) 07 and EWS 03 (including 01 PwBD).

Who Can Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026?

Candidates with relevant educational qualifications in management, finance, commerce and other professional disciplines may be eligible for Exim Bank Management Trainee and Manager positions. Final qualification and experience requirements should be checked against the detailed recruitment advertisement.

  • Management Trainee: Minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent Cumulative Grade Points Average (CGPA), in Graduation. The graduation course should be of a minimum 3-year full-time duration. and Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade or Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost & Management Accountant (CMA). Post Graduation course should be of a minimum 2-year full-time duration, with a specialization in Finance with minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA. In case of CA or CMA, passing the professional examination is sufficient. Membership of ICAI in case of CA is mandatory.
  • Manager: Candidates with relevant graduation, postgraduate or professional qualifications and the required post-qualification work experience may be eligible. The detailed advertisement will specify the accepted qualifications and experience. The detailed notification says Manager posts need at least 60% marks in Graduation and a relevant Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) or CA, which varies by stream, plus at least 4 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field.

Note: Candidates should verify the prescribed qualification, minimum marks, experience and other eligibility conditions before submitting an application. Candidates appearing in their final qualifying examinations by May 2027 may also take the written examination. Post-graduation done through online / correspondence / part-time / distance mode is not accepted.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

  • Management Trainee: The previous recruitment eligibility range was 21 to 28 years. The age limit for the 2026 recruitment is subject to confirmation in the detailed notification. The detailed notification confirms it as not below 21 and not above 28 years as on 01 November 2026.
  • Manager: The minimum and maximum age limits will be specified in the detailed notification. The detailed notification sets it at not below 24 and not above 30 years as on 01 November 2026.
  • Age Relaxation: Applicable category-wise relaxation will be governed by the official recruitment rules. The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (NCL). For PwBD it is relaxed by 10 years (General/EWS), 13 years (OBC-NCL) and 15 years (SC/ST), and Ex-servicemen get up to 5 years.

The age calculation cutoff date and applicable relaxations should be verified from the detailed Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 notification.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

  • General / OBC Candidates: Rs. 600/- (Application fee and intimation charges)
  • SC / ST / PwBD / EWS / Female Candidates: Rs. 100/- (Intimation charges only)
  • Payment Mode: As specified in the official application instructions. Payment is online only (Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards / Mobile Wallets) from 27-11-2026 to 11-12-2026.

The category-wise application fee for this recruitment has not been confirmed in the short notice. Candidates should refer to the detailed notification before making any payment. The detailed notification now confirms the fee shown above, and fees once paid are non-refundable.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Salary

  • Management Trainee: Rs. 65,000/- monthly stipend during the one-year training. After training they are absorbed as Deputy Manager (JM-I) in the pay scale Rs. 48480-2000-62480-2340-67160-2680-85920 (CTC about Rs. 25 lakh a year).
  • Manager (MM-II): Rs. 64820-2340-67160-2680-93960 (CTC about Rs. 30 lakh a year).

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process and Exam Pattern

Selection will be through a Written Test and a Personal Interview. The written test is a subjective Professional Knowledge paper of 100 marks lasting 2 hours 30 minutes. Part I is a compulsory question or case study (40 marks) and in Part II candidates attempt any 6 of 8 questions (60 marks), all based on the selected specialization. The final selection is based on 70% weightage for the written test and 30% for the interview. The exam will be held in Chennai, Guwahati, Kolkata, Mumbai and New Delhi, and interviews in Mumbai and / or New Delhi.

How to Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026

  • Visit the official India Exim Bank website at https://www.eximbankindia.in/.
  • Open the Careers section on the homepage.
  • Find the recruitment advertisement for Management Trainee and Manager posts.
  • Download and read the detailed notification carefully.
  • Check the required educational qualifications, age limit and experience conditions.
  • Open the official online application link when available (the link will be live from 27 November 2026).
  • Complete the registration process using the required personal and contact details.
  • Fill in the application form with accurate educational, personal and professional information.
  • Upload the required documents, photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as instructed.
  • Pay the application fee, if applicable.
  • Submit the completed application form by 11 December 2026 and save a copy for future reference.

The Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) has released the SIDBI Recruitment 2026 notification for 68 Officer vacancies under Grade A and Grade B in General and Specialist Streams. The recruitment includes 63 Assistant Manager Grade A posts and 5 Manager Grade B posts across General, Hindi, Legal and Systems/Information Technology (IT) streams. Eligible candidates can apply online from 21 November 2026 through the official website, sidbi.in. The last date for submitting the application and paying the prescribed fee is 11 December 2026.

According to Advertisement No. 8/Grade 'A' and 'B'/2026-27, applicants must meet the post-specific educational qualification, relevant work experience and age requirements. The age limit is 21 to 30 years for Grade A and 25 to 33 years for Grade B as on 21 November 2026, with applicable relaxations. The selection process consists of Phase I, Phase II and an interview. The online examinations are tentatively scheduled for 27 December 2026, while interviews are expected in February 2027. Candidates should read the official notification carefully before applying because qualifications and experience requirements differ significantly between streams.

SIDBI Grade A and B Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for SIDBI Grade A and Grade B recruitment depends on the post, educational qualification, relevant experience and age limit. Candidates should not assume that a qualification accepted for one stream is automatically valid for another.

The educational qualification and post-qualification experience cut-off date is 11 December 2026. The age eligibility cut-off date is 21 November 2026.

SIDBI Grade A and B Educational Qualification 2026

Assistant Manager Grade A - General Stream

Candidates must possess one of the following qualifications from an appropriately recognized institution:

  • Graduation in Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Administration or Engineering with at least 60% marks in aggregate, or 50% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates where vacancies are reserved for them.
  • Company Secretary (CS), Cost and Management Accountant (CMA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or Chartered Accountant (CA).
  • Two-year full-time MBA or PGDM in any discipline from an institution recognized or approved by the relevant authority.

Applicants pursuing the final year of a qualifying MBA/PGDM programme may apply, subject to producing the required final marksheet and degree certificate at joining if selected.

Assistant Manager Grade A - Hindi Stream

Candidates must meet one of the following educational qualification routes:

  • A bachelor's degree with at least 60% marks (55% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates), with Hindi and English studied as compulsory or elective subjects for at least two years, along with a postgraduate diploma of at least one year in translation between Hindi and English.
  • A master's degree in Hindi with at least 50% marks, with English studied as a main or elective subject for at least two years during graduation.
  • A master's degree in English with at least 50% marks, with Hindi studied as a main or elective subject for at least two years during graduation.

Candidates must be able to translate from English to Hindi and vice versa.

Assistant Manager Grade A - Legal Stream

Applicants must have a bachelor's degree in Law from a recognized university or institution with at least 50% marks in aggregate, or 45% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates where applicable. Candidates must also be enrolled as advocates with the Bar Council of India.

A master's degree in Law, CS qualification and proficiency in computer applications are desirable.

Assistant Manager Grade A - Systems / IT Stream

Applicants must possess a B.E./B.Tech degree in any discipline or an MCA from a recognized institution with at least 60% marks, or 55% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates where the relevant reservation applies.

Preference may be given to candidates with engineering degrees in Computer Science, Computer Technology, Information Technology, Electronics, Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied disciplines.

Relevant certifications in AI/ML, Data Science, Full Stack Application Development, information security or IT service management are desirable.

Manager Grade B - Hindi, Legal and Systems / IT Streams

Grade B applicants must satisfy the relevant specialist-stream educational qualifications:

  • Hindi: A qualifying bachelor's degree with Hindi and English plus a postgraduate translation diploma, or a master's degree in Hindi or English with the prescribed graduation-level language study requirements.
  • Legal: A recognized bachelor's degree in Law with at least 50% marks (45% for eligible reserved-category candidates where applicable) and enrolment as an advocate with the Bar Council of India.
  • Systems / IT: A recognized B.E./B.Tech degree in any discipline or MCA with at least 60% marks, or 55% for eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates where applicable.

Grade B candidates must also possess the prescribed specialist experience. The detailed advertisement should be consulted for accepted employers, duties and technical skill requirements.

SIDBI Grade A and B Recruitment 2026 Work Experience Requirements

Work experience is a major eligibility condition in SIDBI Recruitment 2026. The applicable requirement depends on both the grade and stream.

Post / Stream Required Experience
Grade A General Two years of relevant officer-level experience, or three years of specified clerk/equivalent experience, under the permitted experience routes. An exemption applies to qualifying CA and full-time two-year MBA/PGDM holders.
Grade A Hindi At least 2 years in translation, terminology or Official Language policy-related work
Grade A Legal At least 2 years as a Law Officer in relevant legal, recovery or commercial contract management functions
Grade A Systems / IT At least 2 years in relevant IT or Systems Officer functions
Grade B Hindi At least 5 years of relevant post-qualification experience
Grade B Legal At least 5 years of relevant Law Officer experience
Grade B Systems / IT At least 5 years of relevant IT or Systems Officer experience, including prescribed domain-specific technical experience

Important Experience Exception for SIDBI Grade A General Stream

The official advertisement provides an important exception for candidates holding CA or an MBA/PGDM completed through a two-year full-time programme from a recognized institution. For such candidates, the prescribed Grade A General Stream work-experience requirement is waived.

However, candidates must still satisfy the remaining eligibility conditions and qualify through SIDBI's selection process.

For other Grade A General applicants, relevant work experience must fall within the duties and organizations specified in the official notification. Experience exclusively related to personal, education, vehicle or housing loans is not accepted under the applicable lending-experience provisions.

Grade B specialist candidates should note that the advertisement specifies qualifying permanent or full-time direct contractual experience and excludes third-party payroll experience for the relevant posts.

For Grade A, candidates must have been born between 21 November 1996 and 21 November 2005, both dates inclusive. For Grade B, the eligible birth-date range is 21 November 1993 to 21 November 2001, both dates inclusive, before applicable age relaxation.

Age relaxation is subject to the eligibility conditions and documentary requirements specified in the advertisement. SIDBI staff candidates should refer to the separate departmental relaxation provisions.

SIDBI Grade A and B Salary 2026

SIDBI offers different pay scales for Assistant Manager Grade A and Manager Grade B. The official notification also provides approximate monthly gross emoluments and annual cost-to-company ranges.

Salary Details Grade A Grade B
Starting Basic Pay ₹62,500 ₹78,450
Maximum Basic Pay in Scale ₹1,26,100 ₹1,41,600
Approximate Monthly Gross Emoluments ₹1,20,000 ₹1,45,000
Indicative Annual CTC ₹30–34 Lakh ₹40–43 Lakh

The pay package includes applicable allowances and benefits under SIDBI rules. The actual amount may vary by place of posting and other applicable conditions. Gross emoluments and CTC should not be confused with take-home salary.

Probation and Posting

Selected candidates will normally undergo probation for two years, extendable up to four years at SIDBI's discretion. Officers may be posted or transferred to SIDBI offices, verticals, associates or subsidiaries according to organizational requirements.

This is an officer recruitment and not a deputation-only advertisement. A fixed deputation period is therefore not applicable.

SIDBI Grade A and B Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The application fee and intimation charges are non-refundable and inclusive of applicable GST.

Category Application Fee Intimation Charges Total
SC / ST / PwBD Nil ₹175 ₹175
General / OBC / EWS and Others ₹925 ₹175 ₹1,100

Eligible SIDBI staff candidates must initially pay the applicable fee and intimation charges. Reimbursement is subject to the conditions stated in the official advertisement.

SIDBI Grade A and B Selection Process 2026

The SIDBI Recruitment 2026 selection process comprises three stages:

  1. Phase I - Online screening/objective examination
  2. Phase II - English descriptive examination and stream-specific objective/descriptive examination
  3. Phase III - Interview

Phase I and Phase II will be conducted on the same day in a single sitting. Phase II papers will be evaluated only for candidates who qualify Phase I according to the minimum marks prescribed by SIDBI.

Phase I Exam Pattern

Subject Questions Marks Time
Reasoning Aptitude 15 15 15 Minutes
English Language 15 15 15 Minutes
Quantitative Aptitude 15 15 15 Minutes
General Awareness, Banking and Financial Sector, Economic and Social Issues, and Computer Knowledge 15 15 15 Minutes
Total 60 60 60 Minutes

Phase II and Interview Pattern

Component Maximum Marks
Paper II - English Descriptive 75
Paper III - Stream-specific Objective 75
Paper III - Stream-specific Descriptive 50
Phase II Total 200
Phase III Interview 100

The interview component includes provision for marks relating to notable extracurricular achievements, subject to satisfactory documentary evidence. Candidates should consult the detailed notification for stream-specific syllabi, qualifying marks and other examination rules.

Documents Required for SIDBI Recruitment 2026

Candidates should keep the following documents and details available while completing the application and during subsequent verification stages:

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph
  • Scanned signature in black ink
  • Scanned left thumb impression
  • Handwritten declaration in English
  • Valid personal email ID and mobile number
  • Educational qualification certificates and marksheets
  • Experience certificates and relevant employment records, where applicable
  • Valid identity and date-of-birth proof
  • Applicable SC, ST, OBC, EWS or PwBD certificate
  • No Objection Certificate for specified employed candidates at the interview stage

The photograph, signature, thumb impression and handwritten declaration must follow the image and file specifications provided in the official notification. The online application process also includes live photograph capture.

SIDBI Handwritten Declaration 2026

The declaration must be written in the candidate's own handwriting in English, subject to the accessibility exception specified in the notification.

I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.

Signatures written entirely in capital letters will not be accepted. Candidates should check the detailed advertisement for the required scan specifications.

SIDBI Recruitment 2026 NOC Requirements

Candidates currently serving in Government, quasi-government offices, Public Sector Undertakings, nationalized banks and financial institutions are required to produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the interview stage.

The NOC must specifically permit the candidate to appear for the SIDBI selection interview. SIDBI states that conditional NOCs will not be accepted. Failure to produce an acceptable NOC may result in the candidate not being permitted to attend the interview or continue in the selection process.

How to Apply Online for SIDBI Recruitment 2026

Candidates can submit their applications exclusively through the official SIDBI website between 21 November and 11 December 2026.

  1. Visit the SIDBI website at www.sidbi.in.
  2. Open the Careers & Recruitment section and locate the Grade A and Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 advertisement.
  3. Select the official Apply Online option.
  4. Click "Click here for New Registration" and enter the required name, contact details and email ID.
  5. Save the provisional registration number and password generated by the system.
  6. Complete the personal, educational, experience and other relevant details in the application form.
  7. Upload the required photograph, signature, thumb impression and handwritten declaration according to the instructions.
  8. Use the Preview option to verify the entered information.
  9. After checking all details, select "Complete Registration".
  10. Open the Payment tab and pay the prescribed fee or intimation charges using the available online payment methods.
  11. Submit the application and save the generated e-receipt.
  12. Download or print the completed application form for future reference.

Important: Candidates can apply for only one post. SIDBI states that where multiple applications are submitted, only the latest valid completed application will be retained, and charges paid for other registrations will be forfeited.

Changes will not be permitted after completing registration. Applicants should therefore verify their details before final submission.

RRB Paramedical Exam Pattern 2026

The RRB Paramedical Computer-Based Test consists of 100 multiple-choice questions across four subject areas.

Subject Questions Marks

The examination duration is 90 minutes. The CBT carries one mark for each correct answer and a penalty of one-third of a mark for every incorrect answer.

The Professional Ability syllabus varies according to the paramedical post applied for. Candidates should prepare the subjects specified in the official CEN 05/2026 notification.

RRB Paramedical Mock Test 2026 Features

The official mock test is intended to help candidates understand the key functions of the CBT platform.

  • Computer-based question display
  • Multiple-choice answer selection
  • Question number navigation
  • Save and Next controls
  • Mark for Review option
  • On-screen examination timer
  • Question status indicators
  • Examination instructions
  • Language selection, where available
  • Final submission process

Practising these functions before the examination can help candidates become familiar with the assessment interface and avoid confusion while attempting the actual CBT.

RRB Paramedical Mock Test 2026 Benefits

Understand the CBT Interface

The mock test helps candidates become familiar with how questions, answer options and navigation buttons appear during the online examination.

Practise Question Navigation

Candidates can learn how to move between questions and use the Save and Next and Mark for Review functions.

Improve Time Management

Practising under a timer can help candidates plan how much time to spend on individual questions during the actual 90-minute examination.

Reduce Exam-Day Confusion

Using the practice interface before examination day can make it easier to understand the available controls and instructions.

Develop an Answer-Review Strategy

Candidates can practise reviewing marked questions and checking their responses before final submission.

Candidates can calculate their estimated marks by comparing their recorded answers with the provisional answer key.

Candidates who find an incorrect answer in the KEA KREIS Provisional Answer Key 2026 can submit objections through the official online portal.

Candidates can use the provisional answer key to estimate their performance in the KREIS Teacher Recruitment Examination before the official results are announced.

  • Save the submission acknowledgement for future reference.

KEA will examine the objections received within the prescribed deadline. Candidates should avoid submitting incomplete objections or claims without supporting evidence.

If the authority accepts any objections, the relevant answers may be corrected before the final key is published. The final answer key will serve as the basis for evaluating candidates' responses according to the recruitment rules.

The final answer key release date has not yet been announced. Candidates should regularly visit the official KEA website for further updates.

UPSC CMS 2026 Marking Scheme

  • Each question has four alternative answers.
  • One-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for a wrong answer.
  • Marking more than one answer to a question is treated as a wrong answer, even if one of the marked options is correct the same penalty applies.
  • A question left blank/unattempted carries no penalty.

How to Raise an Objection Against the UPSC CMS Answer Key 2026

UPSC accepts representations against the question paper and provisional answer keys only through its official online portal no email, post, or in-person submissions are entertained.

  1. Log in at upsconline.nic.in using your registered credentials.
  2. Go to "Examinations" and select "Representations on Question Paper & Provisional Answer Keys."
  3. Choose the relevant question, paper, and reason for objection.
  4. Submit supporting justification where the portal allows it.
  5. Submit before the window closes  6:00 PM on the 7th day from the exam date. Nothing is entertained after this deadline.

Uttarakhand TET UTET Online Form 2026 : Educational Qualification

Post Name Qualification
Primary Teacher
  • Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed./BTC). OR
  • Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 45% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed./BTC) obtained in accordance with the NCTE (Recognition, Norms and Procedure) Regulations, 2002. OR
  • Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and a 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.). OR
  • Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education) (D.Ed. Special Education) recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI). OR
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) along with a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed./BTC).
  • Government Primary School Shiksha Mitras working on an honorarium basis who, with the permission of the State Government, have successfully completed the 2-year D.El.Ed. programme from Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU).
  • Regularly appointed Assistant Teachers/Head Teachers (Primary) and Assistant Teachers/Head Teachers (Upper Primary) serving in all categories of schools allotted a DISE Code and teaching Classes 1 to 5 (in-service teachers).
Upper Primary Teacher
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) along with a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (BTC/D.El.Ed.). OR
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and a 1-year Bachelor of Education (B.Ed./L.T./Shiksha Shastri) (Regular/Institutional only). OR
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) with at least 45% marks and a 1-year Bachelor of Education (B.Ed./L.T./Shiksha Shastri) (Regular/Institutional only), obtained in accordance with the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) Regulations issued from time to time. OR
  • Senior Secondary (10+2) or its equivalent with at least 50% marks and a 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.). OR
  • Senior Secondary (10+2) or its equivalent with at least 50% marks and a 4-year B.A. B.Ed. / B.Sc. B.Ed. integrated degree. OR
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and a B.Ed. (Special Education) recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI). OR
  • Graduation or Post-Graduation with at least 50% marks and B.Ed. However, the minimum percentage requirement at the graduation level shall not apply to candidates who were admitted to the B.Ed., Bachelor of Elementary Education, or equivalent teacher education programme before 29 July 2011. OR
  • In-Service Teachers: Regularly appointed Assistant Teachers, Head Teachers, and Assistant Teachers (L.T.) serving in schools having a DISE Code and teaching Classes VI to VIII (6 to 8) are also eligible.
